name: Being A Man Of God
overview: Being a man of God involves embracing strength and courage, knowing that the Lord is always with His people, as Joshua 1:9 encourages. It requires a deep, personal pursuit of God, thirsting for Him even in difficult circumstances, as expressed in Psalm 63:1. Wisdom and understanding are essential, heeding God's instruction attentively (Proverbs 5:1), while living out justice, mercy, and humility in relationship with God, as Micah 6:8 commands. Furthermore, a man of God recognizes his divine calling and purpose, as Jeremiah 1:5 reveals God’s sovereign knowledge and ordination before birth.
